status: Unqualified prototype: remote build, correctness and all performance gates pending
owner_reason: A new portable top-k capability in upstream llama-sampler.cpp; no preceding patch owns top-k selection. It does not reorganize earlier Skippy implementation.

highway.operation: VQPartialSort over integer ordered float keys plus original candidate indices; gather complete selected token records
highway.model_rng: No access to sampler RNG. Highway pivot RNG is independent.

eligibility.fallbacks: Already sorted, small/unsupported sizes, NaN, positive infinity, or equal keys among selected k plus the boundary candidate. Signed zeros map to equal keys. Negative infinity remains supported but selected/boundary ties fall back. Original candidate records and descriptor are untouched until eligibility succeeds.

configurations.default_product_build: OFF; this is an experiment until qualified

spark.flags: Release, C++17, identical per-arm flags other than the declared implementation/control definitions; save actual CMake caches and compilation databases
spark.thermal_guard: NVML current/supported clock-event reasons: refuse unknown required thermal support, thermal slowdown, hardware slowdown or power-brake slowdown. GPU idle and normal software power caps are recorded separately and are not thermal slowdown. CPU temperatures/counters are separate observations, not falsely labeled healthy.
spark.rss_units: Linux getrusage KiB converted to bytes before reporting
spark.harness: One portable harness source snapshot for all four Spark builds; native sources B/C stay frozen. No unknown thermal value can pass the worker guard.

qualification: Unchanged plan.json and spark-plan.json numerical, correctness, completeness and independent recording gates. No timings from builds or profiler jobs.
